title: Working on a extraction rpg
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
Been working on a fantasy extraction rpg called ykwhy, here's some alpha footage.

The twist: modern culture meets medieval fantasy. Buy streetwear in a walled medieval town, then go fight a troll in it.

In the build now  
\-one open map: town, farmland, river, gorge and a keep  
\-loot, fight goblins and trolls, extract before the clock runs out  
\-rival raiders (bots for now) after the same loot  
\-boss lairs that wake mid raid  
\-sound gives you away, climbing and ziplines get you around

Planned  
\-PvP  
\-player driven economy with an auction house  
\-professions: cooking, smithing, fishing

Godot 4, built solo with Claude Code, Codex, Tripo, Meshy and ElevenLabs. Still rough, feedback welcome.
